svg.title: agentseam capability matrix
svg.desc: Grid of 16 coding agents by 12 lifecycle events, shaded by the enforcement grade agentseam can honestly claim at that surface. Of 192 cells: 2 enforceable; 33 best-effort; 56 detect; 101 none. No agent is graded enforced at any event -- eleven agents reach only best-effort at pre_tool, Cursor alone reaches enforceable there, and aider, Copilot, Replit and Zed have no hook surface at pre_tool at all.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
